semiconductor_relevance: High — Shin-Etsu Polymer India specializes in equipment and containers for the secure transport and processing of semiconductor wafers.
summary: Shin-Etsu Polymer India Pvt Ltd manufactures specialized equipment for the semiconductor industry, including Front Opening Unified Pods (FOUPs) and automated transport containers for 300mm wafers. Their products ensure clean and secure wafer handling, optimizing automation in semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.India: Shin-Etsu Polymer India operates within the Indian market, focusing on the semiconductor equipment sector.
